entities.summary: Lazar Mamula was an Austro-Hungarian general and governor of Dalmatia. Of Serbian ancestry, he is today often associated with the contentious Prevlaka peninsula where he constructed a fort on the slip of land overlooking the Gulf of Kotor and his active association with other Slavic leaders in the Habsburg monarchy at the time. Lazarus von Mamula was a military leaders & commanders from Gomirje (1795-05-22, Gomirje–1878-01-12). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
